title: Terminal Security Sweep — No Anomalies Found

fields.location: Terminal Concourse A, Concourse B, Baggage Claim Level 1, Gate A1–A8, Security Screening Area
fields.summary: Routine sweep of the terminal conducted following the receipt of a threat email. No suspicious packages, unattended items, or unauthorized individuals were observed. All access points, including SIDA zones, were verified as secured and compliant with badge requirements. No evidence of tampering, sabotage, or external intrusion. The threat remains purely digital in nature, consistent with prior intelligence.

findings.notes: All doors secured, no forced entry signs
No unattended bags, no debris, no visible disturbances
All checkpoints manned, no equipment failures

findings.item: SIDA zones (Concourse A, B, North Cargo Ramp)
findings.notes: All personnel wearing badges; no challenges issued
No signs of forced entry or damage

findings.item: Electrical and utility closets (near Gate B3)
findings.notes: All locks intact, no power fluctuations noted
No obstructions, no blocked signage
No disturbances, no suspicious behavior
All gates secured, no unauthorized personnel
All cameras online and pointed correctly

actionsTaken: Conducted sweep using patrol vehicle and foot patrol
Verified badge compliance in SIDA zones
Reviewed camera feeds from NCIA-VIDEO-A (SEC-NVR-01) for 08:55–09:15
Notified IT Security of no physical anomalies found
recommendations: Continue monitoring for digital anomalies via SIEM and network logs
Reinforce badge compliance training for all staff
fields.photosNote: 6 photos attached: IMG_0418-0423 (gate A1 entry, SIDA zone A, restroom exterior, camera feed screenshot, patrol vehicle log, badge verification stamp)

instructorNote: This inject confirms the threat is digital. The security team has followed protocol, but the absence of physical evidence reinforces that the attacker’s method is cyber-based. Watch for over-reaction to the dead end—some players may misinterpret the lack of findings as a sign of a physical threat that has been hidden.
